notes: Simulated resolution: 7.1 takes 60 of 168 keys (baby, boy, girl, man, woman, blond trio, old man, old woman) and android-12 takes 108 (child 1f9d2, person 1f9d1, older person 1f9d3, the beard family, and every red/curly/white/bald hair ZWJ). Harmony risk: the 7.1 faces have no eyebrows and a D-shaped open smile, while the android-12 (=11) faces have eyebrows, a closed smile and shaded hair. At 20px the gap is small, because both are yellow round heads with flat-colour shirts on the busts, but the generational trio man/woman (7.1) vs person (android-12) and child (12) next to boy/girl (7.1) will show it in the picker. 7.1 1f471 base is identical to the man variant (male blond), whereas the modern base is gender-neutral. I chose 7.1 so the core people match person-gesture, person-role and family (the 7.1 family composites use these same heads). If the owner prefers in-subgroup uniformity, android-12 is the alternative. None of the =11 fallbacks are bordered clip-art (android-11 people have no dark outline), so I listed none for redraw.
